Theming

Every widget reads its colours from the theme. Call initializeTheme() once, before any widget renders, to customise the default behaviour. 

// Initialize the theme with a custom color
initializeTheme({ color: "gray", center: true });

Press Ctrl+K to open the colour picker. The sample output looks like color: gray.

Options

OptionDefaultWhat it does
color"gray"The colour used for borders and dividers.
centerfalseCentres the label in the widget.

Try it

Type a color name here, like gray.

The ColorPro Studio plugin adds a palette of favourite colours.
